# SIM PACK: Northwind Labs, AI Engineer

Interview: mixed, standard, 15 min, language en

## COMPETENCIES
[c1] Shipping LLM features | posting: "You have shipped at least one LLM feature to production users."
[c2] Evaluation discipline | posting: "You measure quality with evals, not vibes."
[c3] Clear communication | posting: "You communicate clearly with non-technical colleagues."

## CANDIDATE EVIDENCE
[e1] project | Led Lantern, an LLM pipeline that extracts structured fields from supplier invoices. | cv:L4
[e2] metric | Lantern cut manual data entry from 11 minutes to 2 minutes per invoice. | cv:L5
[e3] story | Built a 300-invoice golden set and ran it on every prompt change before release. | note:L2

## QUESTION PLAN
[q1] opener | Tell me a bit about yourself and what brings you to this role. | competencies: c3 | evidence: e1 | target 60-90 s
  follow-up: Ask what they enjoy most about building LLM products.
[q2] behavioural | Tell me about an LLM feature you shipped to real users. How did you know it worked? | competencies: c1, c2 | evidence: e1, e2, e3 | target 60-120 s
  follow-up: Ask for the metric that proved it worked.
  follow-up: Ask how they caught regressions before release.
[q3] motivation | Why Northwind Labs, and why now? | competencies: c3 | evidence: none | target 45-90 s
  follow-up: Ask what they would want to learn in their first three months.

## RUBRIC
[c1] 1: No shipped feature, or only demos. | 3: Shipped a feature but cannot say what changed for users. | 5: Shipped to real users and names the measured outcome.
[c2] 1: Judges quality by feel. | 3: Mentions tests or spot checks. | 5: Describes a repeatable eval set run before each release.
[c3] 1: Rambling or jargon-heavy. | 3: Clear but generic. | 5: Clear, concrete and adapted to the listener.
